**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)  
**Order Date:** May 24, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for a continuous glucose monitor has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**Diagnosis Requirement:** Met. Patient has an active diagnosis of Type 1 diabetes mellitus, established February 16, 2018.

**Clinical Need Requirement:** Met. Patient is currently treated with insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime (started September 19, 2024), satisfying the insulin therapy criterion.

**Recent Evaluation Requirement:** Met. An in-person diabetes follow-up visit was documented on January 16, 2025 (128 days prior to order), within the required 6-month window. The visit note by Dr. A. Rivera documents review of glucose log and HbA1c, assessment of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, and discussion of continuous glucose monitoring.

---

The patient meets all medical necessity criteria for CGM coverage. Please proceed with the prescription.

If you have questions, contact us at [phone number].
